name: SIA308 [驾驶舱烟雾，错过脱离道]

cards.audioText: B: [Your callsign is SIA308, a flight from Wuhan to Frankfurt. You’re parking at gate M5. You got the latest information G, contact Wuhan Delivery for ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是新航308，从武汉飞往法兰克福。你现在在M5号停机位。你收到了最新的通播G，联系武汉放行，申请管制许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA308, gate M5, information G, request ATC clearance to Frankfurt.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新航308，M5号机位，通播G，请求飞往法兰克福的管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb 1600m, ZF05 departure, cruising level 11000m, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3763.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，可以经由计划航路飞往法兰克福，离场跑道04，初始爬升至1600米，ZF05离场，巡航高度11000米，离场频率119.45，应答机3763。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb 1600m, ZF05 departure, cruising level 11000m, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3763, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往法兰克福，离场跑道04，初始爬升至1600米，ZF05离场，巡航高度11000米，离场频率119.45，应答机3763，新航308。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’ve completed pushback and start-up, you’re ready for taxi. Contact Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: B: 【你现在完成了推出开车，你准备好滑行了，联系武汉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA308, pushback and start-up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航308，完成推出开车，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, Wuhan Ground, taxi via taxiway Z4, A2, A to the holding point of E5 runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，武汉地面，经由滑行道Z4，A2和A滑行到跑道04外等待点E5。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A2, A to the holding point of E5 runway 04, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4，A2和A滑行到跑道04外等待点E5，新航308。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’re holding at holding point E5, runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower and tell controller you’re ready for departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: B: 【现在你已经在跑道04外等待点E5，联系武汉塔台，告诉管制员你准备好起飞了。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA308, holding point E5, runway 04, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航308，跑道04外等待点E5，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, line up runway 04, and cleared for immediate takeoff, traffic on final.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，上跑道04，可以立即起飞，五边上有航空器。
cards.referenceText: Line up runway 04, and cleared for immediate takeoff, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道04，可以立即起飞，新航308。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’re airborne, passing 600m, climbing to 1600m, contact Wuhan Departure and ask for cancel SID and proceed to ZF.]
cards.audioTextZh: B: 【你现在已经起飞，过600米，正向1600米爬升，联系武汉离场，请求取消标准离场，直飞ZF。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA308, airborne, passing 600m, climbing to 1600m, request cancel SID and proceed to ZF.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，新航308，起飞了，过600米，正向1600米爬升，请求取消标准离场，直飞ZF。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, cancel SID, turn right direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 4500m.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，武汉离场，雷达看见了，取消标准离场，右转直飞ZF，上4500米保持。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, turn right direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 4500m, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消标准离场，右转直飞ZF，上4500米保持，新航308。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’re en-route Germany, Rhein Radar Control, you’re cruising at FL360, make an initial contact with Rhein Radar Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在已经在德国莱茵雷达管制区航路上，你现在在高度层360巡航。与莱茵雷达管制区进行初始通话。】
cards.referenceText: Rhein Radar, SIA308, en-route, cruising at FL360.
cards.referenceTextZh: 莱茵雷达，新航308，在航路上，高度层360。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, maintain FL360, offset 3 miles right of track due weather ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，保持高度层360，由于天气，右偏置3海里。
cards.referenceText: Maintain FL360, offset 3 miles right of track, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持高度层360，右偏置3海里，新航308。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you have smoke in the cockpit, make a distress call to Rhein Radar and request emergency descent to remove the smoke.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你的驾驶舱出现烟雾，向莱茵雷达管制区做遇险呼叫，请求紧急下降来移除烟雾。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Rhein Radar, SIA308, we have smoke in the cockpit, request emergency descent for smoke removal.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，莱茵雷达，新航308，驾驶舱烟雾，请求紧急下降来移除烟雾。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA308, roger Mayday, descend to and maintain FL100, keep us advised the situation on board and your intention.
B: [Read back the instructions and tell the controller that you’re working the checklist and will advise.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 新航308，收到Mayday，下高度层100保持，告知我们机上情况以及你的意图。
B：【复诵指令，告知管制员，你现在正在执行检查单。】
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain FL100, we’re working the checklist and will advise, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到高度层100保持，我们正在执行检查单，将会告知，新航308。

cards.audioText: B: [After completing the checklist, the smoke can’t be removed and you decide to divert to Paris, inform the controller your situation and intention.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【完成检查单后，烟雾无法移除，你决定改航到巴黎，告知管制员你的情况以及意图。】
cards.referenceText: Rhein Radar, SIA308, the smoke can’t be removed, request divert to Paris.
cards.referenceTextZh: 莱茵雷达，新航308，烟雾无法移除，请求改航到巴黎。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, roger, turn left heading 350, descend to and maintain 8000ft, contact Paris Approach 119.4.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，收到，左转航向350，下到8000英尺保持，联系巴黎进近119.4。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 350, descend to and maintain 8000ft, contact Paris Approach 119.4, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向350，下到8000英尺保持，联系巴黎进近119.4，新航308。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, descend to and maintain 6000ft, cleared for ILS approach runway 08L.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，下6000英尺保持，可以盲降进近跑道08左。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 6000ft, cleared for ILS approach runway 08L, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下6000英尺保持，可以盲降进近跑道08左，新航308。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’ve landed on runway 08L, but you missed the first rapid exit, report to Paris Tower and request vacate via the second rapid exit.]
cards.audioTextZh: B: 【现在你已经落地跑道08左，但是你错过了第一个快速脱离道，联系巴黎塔台，请求从第二个快速脱离道脱离。】
cards.referenceText: Paris Tower, SIA308, we missed the first rapid exit, request vacate via the second rapid exit.
cards.referenceTextZh: 巴黎塔台，新航308，我们错过了第一个快速脱离道，请求经由第二个快速脱离道脱离。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, roger, take second rapid exit, when vacated, contact Paris on 118.5.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，收到，经由第二个快速脱离道脱离，脱离后，联系巴黎118.5。
cards.referenceText: Take second rapid exit, when vacated, contact Paris on 118.5, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由第二个快速脱离道脱离，脱离后，联系巴黎118.5，新航308。
